name: Hearing Loss
overview: Hearing Loss is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include partial or total inability to hear. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: Health professionals note that hearing loss is either a partial inability to hear, or a total inability termed deafness.
Health professionals note that hearing loss may be present at birth or acquired at any time afterwards.
In routine practice, hearing loss may occur in one or both ears.
From a clinical perspective, in children, hearing problems can affect the ability to acquire spoken language.
From a clinical perspective, in adults, it can create difficulties with social interaction and at work.

faq.question: Can I rely on this Hearing Loss information instead of a doctor visit?

faq.question: When should I worry about hearing loss?
